title: diff.json
description: One measured model, as the diff of README section 3, Stage E publishes it: row count, removed primary keys, columns with altered values, and the value of each metric. The tools do not produce this file - that is warehouse-specific - they only demand its shape. Its keys mirror the pre-registration on purpose.

model.description: must name the dbt model these numbers were measured on

row_delta.description: must be the rows in the PR build minus the rows in production, inside the window, as a whole number

removed_pks.description: must be how many primary keys exist in production and not in the PR build

altered_columns.description: must list the columns with at least one primary-key-matched row whose value differs

delta_pct.description: must be (pr - prod) / prod * 100, in percentage points written as a plain number, or null when the production value is 0

additionalProperties.description: must be an object with a delta_pct

metrics.description: must hold one measurement per metric; write {} when the model has none

model_value.description: must be the number the reconciliation query read from the model

external_value.description: must be the number the reconciliation query read from the source of truth outside the warehouse

reconciliation.description: must give both numbers the reconciliation query returned; critical models need it

column.description: must name the event_time column the window was cut on

start.description: must be where the window starts, identical on both sides of the diff

end.description: must be where the window ends, identical on both sides of the diff

window.description: must describe the closed window both sides were measured over; compare prints it for the reviewer

extra.description: anything else the team wants to carry along; the tools ignore it
